title: Biometric Presentation Manifest
description: Schema for tracking biometric samples in the FaceNet-EMAR project.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific presentation sample.

subject_id.description: True identity of the person presenting. Must not be a real name or NIP.

claimed_subject_id.description: The identity claimed by the presenter.

consent_version.description: Version of the consent form signed by the subject.

consent_status.description: Current status of the subject's consent.

session_id.description: Identifier for the data collection session to track environment grouping.

source_media_id.description: Filename or ID of the raw media.

source_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the raw media file for reproducibility.

pai_species.description: Presentation Attack Instrument species (NONE for bona fide).

lux.description: Illuminance in lux during capture (if recorded).

distance_cm.description: Estimated distance from camera in cm.

device_id.description: Identifier for the capture device used.

enrollment_role.description: Whether this sample is used to create the gallery reference or acts as a probe.

quality_status.description: Manual or automated quality assessment prior to evaluation.

exclusion_reason.description: Reason for exclusion (if split is EXCLUDED).
